featured_reviews.name: Uma Chekkithadka
featured_reviews.review_text:
In-store experience was good. Mr. Tashleem did a great job in explaining the features of the product and giving a demo of Eureka Forbes robo vacuum cleaner.
However, the customer service/ delivery helpline wasn't helpful at all. I was told the product will be delivered the next day with no update till half an hour before delivery which happened in the afternoon. When I tried to contact Vijay Sales because I had some errands to run and needed a confirmation of expected delivery time, there was no response at all. I tried 2-3 numbers, (tried with email, WhatsApp too) spent over 40 mins frantically trying to connect. At one point, I suspected I got scammed. Vijay Sales may improve this aspect. Give order confirmation, delivery updates, contact number of delivery person etc. to avoid unnecessary anxiety.
If I were to rate my overall experience, I'd rate 3 star.

featured_reviews.name: Noorali Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Service by Naushad Shaikh
I had a great experience purchasing my phone with the help of Naushad Shaikh. He was very polite, helpful, and guided me to get the best deal available. He patiently answered all my questions and made the entire buying process smooth and hassle-free.
As a nice gesture, he also provided a free power bank and headphones, which was greatly appreciated. His customer service and professional attitude made the experience even better.
Highly recommended! Thank you, Naushad, for your excellent support and service. 😊

featured_reviews.review_text: Pradnya idfc  has been really wonderful... I was struggling with emi.. but she made it very comfortable and smooth and my loan was processed.  She went out of her and helped me. Super staff

featured_reviews.name: Suraj Rai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Service can be be improved by a lot. On 26th January 2026, we had to wait in line for probably close to 45 minutes to one hour at billing section. Second thing, they managed to delete my remaining points from system unknowingly, after lot of convincing they did relook and did the reversal of 500 Rs. Third thing, they have managed to forget the gift (multi purpose watch) entry in final invoice handed over to us. One of the friendly staff has said that he has applied for reversal of invoice again and we may have to reprocess the invoice by tomorrow again.

Genuine feedback. Vijay Sales Team, though I understand rush might have been bit higher compared to regular days however you need to definitely work on your customer service, especially at billing system and inter-Team communication management. Hope all goes well tomorrow if at all my involvement is required for revision in invoice and I expect to receive the revised bill soft copy at least as that will ensure support on the device received in gift.

featured_reviews.review_text: Great experience at Vijay sales today! I was looking for a specific mixer and the staff was incredibly knowledgeable. They helped me compare brands without being pushy. The shop is well-organized and has a solid range of high-quality components. I’ll definitely be back for my next project.

featured_reviews.review_text: It’s one of the most popular place to shop for electronics accessories and home appliances. We always prefer to see the goods we are about to buy rather than online. Another advantage of Vijay Sales is their efficient service. They explain to you all the details of products and their functioning. On most of the products, one can do reasonable bargaining if you know the real online prices.

featured_reviews.name: Arpit pandey
featured_reviews.review_text: i always prefer vijay sales for electronic items but this time i brought Realme 16 pro phone on the 2nd say camera was not working ...i contact to vijay sales team Sujeet and Nitin was there they wear sending me to service centre Dadar its not the solution i want replacement cuz its been only 12 days getting new phone .plz @vijaysales help me to get replacement hu🙁

featured_reviews.name: Chooomantar - Gotta play ‘em all!
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Vijay Sales in Bandra West to purchase a Google Pixel 10, and I had a really excellent experience thanks to Saif from the Google team.

Saif was extremely polite, patient, and very knowledgeable about the product. He explained all the features of the Pixel 10 in a clear and practical way, and he made sure all my doubts were addressed without rushing the conversation. What stood out the most was how confidently he handled every question, it was clear that he genuinely understands the product inside out.

His approach was not pushy at all. Instead, he focused on helping me understand what I was buying and how I could get the best out of the device. Because of the way he explained the phone’s features and capabilities, I felt very confident about my decision to purchase the Pixel 10.

It’s rare to come across someone in retail who is both so courteous and so well-informed. Saif represents the brand very well, and he made the whole buying experience smooth and pleasant.

Kudos to him and the team at Vijay Sales Bandra West for such great customer service.

I had the most seamless and wonderful experience with JP electronics on the back of a not so wonderful experience at the Apple Store.

My iPad Pro was not turning on and after running it through their diagnostics I was told by the Apple Genius Bar that it was a mother board issue and cost of repair was 60 k and I might as well buy a new iPad.

I’m so glad I got a second opinion at JP. They fixed my iPad that had an issue with charging ( not motherboard ) for a tiny fraction of the cost

featured_reviews.name: eureka alphonso
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a time capsule.. stepping in took me back to a time when life was so much more simple. Right from the motherly receptionist to the warm owner. Such a genuine guy who remembers and calls you by name. He’s also upfront about prices so that made me feel safe. You have my heartfelt thanks and I wish you all the best.
